## Families Struggling in Our Region

```{r region_table}
# Read in data
all_fam_region <- read_csv("../data/family_race_county_summary.csv") |> 
  filter(group=="All Families") |> 
  filter(inc_v_budget=="inc_under_budget") |> 
  select("locality","year","group","est_prop_adj","total_families","percent")

all_fam_region <- all_fam_region[order(all_fam_region$locality), ]


all_fam_region_total <- all_fam_region |> 
  group_by(year, group) |> 
  summarise(est_prop_adj = sum(est_prop_adj),
            total_families = sum(total_families)) |> 
  mutate(percent = round(est_prop_adj/total_families *100, 2)) |> 
  mutate(locality = "Total for Region", .before = year) |> 
  ungroup()

all_fam_region_table <- rbind(all_fam_region, all_fam_region_total)

# Region self sufficiency totals table ----
all_fam_region_table %>% 
  mutate(percent = percent/100) %>% 
  # ungroup() %>% 
  select(c(locality, est_prop_adj, percent)) %>%
  gt(rowname_col = "locality") %>% 
  cols_label(
    est_prop_adj = "Number of Struggling Families",
    percent = "Percent of Struggling Families"
  ) %>% 
  fmt_number(columns = est_prop_adj, 
             decimals = 0, 
             sep_mark = ",") %>%
  fmt_percent(
    columns = percent,
    decimals = 0
  ) %>% 
  tab_style(
    style = list(
      cell_fill(color = "#F6D2A9"),
      cell_text(weight = "bold")
    ),
    locations = list(cells_body(rows = 8), cells_stub(rows = 8))
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(align = "center", v_align = "middle"),
    locations = list(cells_column_labels(), cells_body())
  ) %>% 
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = list(cells_column_labels())
  ) %>% 
  tab_header(
    title = "Summary of Struggling Families in the Region"
  ) %>% 
  tab_source_note(
    source_note = "Note: Values are approximate based on the U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-year estimates (2020-2024)"
  )

```

```{r region_table_type}
# Read in data
fam_type_region <- read_csv("../data/family_type_county_2024.csv") |> 
  filter(inc_v_budget=="inc_under_budget") |> 
  select("locality","year","child_in_home","est_prop_adj","total_families_by_group","percent") |> 
  mutate(child_in_home = case_when(str_detect(child_in_home, "With own") ~ "with_child",
                                   str_detect(child_in_home, "No own") ~ "no_child")) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = child_in_home, values_from = c(est_prop_adj, total_families_by_group, percent))

fam_type_region <- fam_type_region[order(fam_type_region$locality), ]

fam_type_region_total <- fam_type_region |> 
  group_by(year) |> 
  summarise(est_prop_adj_with_child = sum(est_prop_adj_with_child),
            est_prop_adj_no_child = sum(est_prop_adj_no_child),
            total_families_by_group_with_child = sum(total_families_by_group_with_child),
            total_families_by_group_no_child = sum(total_families_by_group_no_child)) |> 
  mutate(percent_with_child = round(est_prop_adj_with_child/total_families_by_group_with_child *100, 2),
         percent_no_child = round(est_prop_adj_no_child/total_families_by_group_no_child *100, 2)) |> 
  mutate(locality = "Total for Region", .before = year) |> 
  ungroup()

fam_type_region_table <- rbind(fam_type_region, fam_type_region_total)

# Region self sufficiency totals table ----
fam_type_region_table %>% 
  mutate(percent_with_child = percent_with_child/100,
         percent_no_child = percent_no_child/100) %>% 
  # ungroup() %>% 
  select(c(locality, est_prop_adj_with_child, percent_with_child, est_prop_adj_no_child, percent_no_child)) %>%
  gt(rowname_col = "locality") %>% 
  cols_label(
    est_prop_adj_with_child = "Number",
    percent_with_child = "Percent",
    est_prop_adj_no_child = "Number",
    percent_no_child = "Percent"
  ) %>% 
  tab_spanner(
    label = "Struggling Families With Children Under 18 yrs.",
    columns = c(est_prop_adj_with_child,percent_with_child)
  ) %>% 
  tab_spanner(
    label = "Struggling Families With No Children Under 18 yrs.",
    columns = c(est_prop_adj_no_child, percent_no_child)
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(est_prop_adj_with_child, est_prop_adj_no_child), 
             decimals = 0, 
             sep_mark = ",") %>%
  fmt_percent(
    columns = c(percent_with_child, percent_no_child),
    decimals = 0
  ) %>% 
  tab_style(
    style = list(
      cell_fill(color = "#F6D2A9"),
      cell_text(weight = "bold")
    ),
    locations = list(cells_body(rows = 8), cells_stub(rows = 8))
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(align = "center", v_align = "middle"),
    locations = list(cells_column_labels(), cells_body())
  ) %>% 
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = list(cells_column_spanners())
  ) %>% 
  tab_header(
    title = "Summary of Struggling Families With and Without Children Under 18 in the Region"
  ) %>% 
  tab_source_note(
    source_note = "Note: Values are approximate based on the U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-year estimates (2020-2024)"
  )

```

### Undervalued Labor  (TJ Planning District)
```{r}
workers_by_hours <- read_csv("../data/pums_workers_by_hours.csv") %>% 
  mutate(
    hours_bin = factor(hours_bin, levels = c("Unemployed", "Less than 20", "20 to 29", "30 to 34", "35 to 39", "40 or more"), labels = c("Unemployed", "Less than 20 hours", "20 to 29 hours", "30 to 34 hours", "35 to 39 hours", "40 or more hours")),
         label_text = case_when(
           below_budget_finc == "Yes" ~ paste0(prettyNum(count, big.mark=",", preserve.width="none"), " (", round(percent, 0), "%)"),
           below_budget_finc == "No" ~ paste0(prettyNum(count, big.mark=",", preserve.width="none"), " (", round(percent, 0), "%)")),
         below_budget_finc = factor(below_budget_finc, levels = c("Yes", "No"),
                                 labels = c("Income Below Budget", "Income Above Budget")))

workers_by_hours %>% 
  filter(below_budget_finc == "Income Below Budget") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = count, y = hours_bin)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = blue_dot) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label_text),
            vjust = 0.5,
            hjust = -0.1,
            size = 4.5) +
  scale_y_discrete(name = "") +
  scale_x_continuous(name = "Number of Workers",
                     breaks = seq(0, 12000, by = 2500),
                     label=comma,
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .3))) +
  labs(title = "Weekly Hours Worked for Workers Earning Below Survival Budget",
       # subtitle = geography_label,
       # caption = acs_pums
       ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.title=element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
        # legend.location = "plot",
        legend.justification="center",
          # panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          plot.title.position= "plot",
          plot.caption.position = "plot",
        axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
        text = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=12),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 16),
        plot.caption = element_text(size = 12))
```

```{r}
#| label: all-fam-budget
#| eval: false

# Read in data
all_fam_budget <- read_csv("../data/budgets_all_families_2024.csv") |> 
  select("County","Categories","Average Family") |> 
  rename(Monthly = "Average Family") |> 
  filter(! Categories %in% c("ANNUAL TOTAL", "Hourly Wage")) |> 
  mutate(Categories = case_when(Categories=="Monthly Total" ~ "Total Income Needed to Meet Budget",
                                .default = Categories),
         Annual = Monthly *12)

all_fam_budget_table <- all_fam_budget %>% 
  filter(County == local_name)

all_fam_budget_table %>% 
  select(-c(County)) %>%
  gt(rowname_col = "Categories") %>% 
  fmt_currency(
    columns = 2:3,
    currency = currency(
      html = "&#36;",
      default = "$"
    ),
    decimals = 2
  ) %>% 
  tab_style(
    style = list(
      cell_fill(color = "#F6D2A9"),
      cell_text(weight = "bold")
    ),
    locations = list(cells_body(rows = 9), cells_stub(rows = 9))
  ) %>% 
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(align = "center", v_align = "middle"),
    locations = list(cells_column_labels(), cells_body())
  ) %>% 
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = list(cells_column_labels())
  ) %>% 
  tab_header(
    title = paste0("Average Survival Budget for Families in ",  local_name)
  ) %>% 
  tab_source_note(
    source_note = "Note: The Average Family Survival Budget is calculated using the ALICE 2024 Survival Budget by family compositions."
  ) |> 
  cols_width(Categories ~ pct(50)) |> 
  tab_options(
    table.width = pct(100)
  )
```

```{r}
  filter(group == "All Families") |>

  group_by(GEOID, locality, year, group, inc_group) |> 
  summarise(estimate = sum(estimate),
            total_families = first(total_families)) |> 
  mutate(inc_group = factor(inc_group, levels = c("below_15k", "below_30k", "below_45k", "below_60k", "below_75k", "below_100k", "above_100k"), labels = c("Less than $15,000","$15,000-$29,999", "$30,000-$44,999", "$45,000-$59,999", "$60,000-$74,999", "$75,000-$99,999", "$100,000 or more")),
         percent = round(estimate/total_families * 100, 2))

inc_band_local <- inc_bands_region |> filter(str_detect(locality,local_name)) 

inc_band_local |> 
  filter(inc_group != "$100,000 or more") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = estimate, y = inc_group, fill = inc_group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +

            vjust = 0.5,

                     ) +

  labs(title = "Number of Families by Annual Income Bands",
       subtitle = local_name,

        legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.title.position= "plot",
        plot.caption.position = "plot",
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 11))
```

```{r}
# Read in data
med_inc_tract <- read_csv("../data/med_faminc_tract_2024.csv") |>  
  filter(county == local_name)

med_inc_tract <- med_inc_tract %>% 
  mutate(GEOID = as.character(GEOID),
         tractnames = case_when(med_inc_below == TRUE ~ paste0(tractnames,"*"),
                                .default = tractnames)) %>%
  rename(tract = NAME) |> 
  filter(year == 2024) %>% 
  left_join(tract_geo, by = join_by(GEOID == GEOID)) %>%
  st_as_sf() 

med_inc_tract <- med_inc_tract[order(med_inc_tract$tractnames, decreasing=FALSE),]

min_inc <- min(med_inc_tract$estimate, na.rm = TRUE)
max_inc <- max(med_inc_tract$estimate, na.rm = TRUE)

med_inc_map <- med_inc_tract %>%
  mutate(estimate = round(estimate, -3),
         text = paste0("$", prettyNum((estimate/1000), big.mark=",", preserve.width="none"), "K")) %>%
  ggplot() +
  annotation_map_tile(zoomin = 1, progress = "none", cachedir = "../data/tempdata/") +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = round(estimate,0)), color = "white") +
  geom_sf_text(aes(label = text), size = 3.5, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_stepsn(colors = pal_inc,
                    labels = scales::label_currency(scale = 1),
                    # n.breaks = 6,
                    trans = "log",
                    n.breaks = 7,
                    limits = c(min_inc, max_inc),
                    na.value = "grey70",
                    guide = guide_colourbar(title = "Median Family Income",
                                            title.position = "top",
                                            direction = "horizontal",
                                            title.hjust = 0.5,
                                            theme = theme(legend.key.height  = unit(0.5, "lines"),
                                                          legend.key.width = unit(26, "lines"),
                                                          text = element_text(size = 10)) 
                                            )
                    )+
  labs(title = "Median Family Income by Census Tract",
      subtitle = local_name
      # caption = source_acs
      ) +
  theme_map()+
  theme(legend.position="top",
        legend.position.inside=c(1, 1.06),
        legend.justification="center",
        plot.title = element_text(size = 16),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14),
        plot.caption = element_text(size = 9))

med_inc_map
```

```{r}
#| label: over-65-budget
#| eval: false

# Read in data
over_65_budget <- read_csv("../data/budgets_65plus_households_2024.csv") |> 
  select("County","Categories","Average Budget 65+ Household") |> 
  rename(Monthly = "Average Budget 65+ Household") |> 
  filter(! Categories %in% c("ANNUAL TOTAL", "Hourly Wage")) |> 
  mutate(Categories = case_when(Categories=="Monthly Total" ~ "Total Income Needed to Meet Budget",
                                .default = Categories),
         Annual = Monthly *12)

over_65_budget_table <- over_65_budget %>% 
  filter(County == local_name)

over_65_budget_table %>% 
  select(-c(County)) %>%
  gt(rowname_col = "Categories") %>% 
  fmt_currency(
    columns = 2:3,
    currency = currency(
      html = "&#36;",
      default = "$"
    ),
    decimals = 2
  ) %>% 
  tab_style(
    style = list(
      cell_fill(color = "#F6D2A9"),
      cell_text(weight = "bold")
    ),
    locations = list(cells_body(rows = 9), cells_stub(rows = 9))
  ) %>% 
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(align = "center", v_align = "middle"),
    locations = list(cells_column_labels(), cells_body())
  ) %>% 
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = list(cells_column_labels())
  ) %>% 
  tab_header(
    title = paste0("Average Survival Budget for Households 65+ in ", local_name)
  ) %>% 
  tab_source_note(
    source_note = "Note: The Average Household Survival Budget is calculated using the ALICE 2024 Survival Budget by family compositions."
  ) |> 
  cols_width(Categories ~ pct(50)) |> 
  tab_options(
    table.width = pct(100)
  )
```

```{r over-65-budget-alb, out.width = '100%'}
#| ref.label: over-65-budget
```

```{r}
#| label: income-bands-65plus
#| eval: false

# Read in data
inc_bands_65plus_region <- read_csv("../data/income_bands_65over_tract_2024.csv") |> 
  separate(NAME, into=c("tract","locality", "state"), sep="; ", remove=FALSE) |> 
  rename(inc_band = variable) |> 
  filter(inc_band != "Total Households 65+") |> 
  group_by(locality, year, group, inc_group, inc_band) |> 
  summarise(estimate = sum(estimate),
            total_hh_65over = sum(total_hh_65over)) |> 
  group_by(locality, year, group, inc_group) |> 
  summarise(estimate = sum(estimate),
            total_hh_65over = first(total_hh_65over)) |> 
  mutate(inc_group = factor(inc_group, levels = c("below_15k", "below_30k", "below_45k", "below_60k", "below_75k", "below_100k", "above_100k"), labels = c("Less than $15,000","$15,000-$29,999", "$30,000-$44,999", "$45,000-$59,999", "$60,000-$74,999", "$75,000-$99,999", "$100,000 or more")),
         percent = round(estimate/total_hh_65over * 100, 2))

inc_band_65plus_local <- inc_bands_65plus_region |> filter(str_detect(locality, local_name) )

inc_band_65plus_local |> 
  # filter(inc_group != "$100,000 or more") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = estimate, y = inc_group, fill = inc_group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(prettyNum(estimate, big.mark=",", preserve.width="none"), " (", round(percent, 0), "%)")),
            vjust = 0.5,
            hjust = -0.1,
            size = 5) +
  scale_y_discrete(name = "Households 65+ Annual Income") +
  scale_x_continuous(name = "Number of Households 65+",
                     breaks = seq(0, 4000, by = 1000),
                     label=comma,
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .3))
                     ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#DE8A5A", "#DE8A5A", "#EDBB8A","#EDBB8A","#B4C8A8","#B4C8A8","grey"))+
  labs(title = "Number of Households 65+ by Annual Income Bands",
       subtitle = local_name,
       # caption = acs_pums
       ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.title=element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.title.position= "plot",
        plot.caption.position = "plot",
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 11))

```
